title: A Bag of Concepts? Testing Role-Filler Binding in the Verbalizable Workspace
abstract: arXiv:2611.19176v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Runtime alignment monitors built on a verbalizable workspace have been proposed as a way to surface a model's silent cognition before it produces output. Their value rests on the workspace carrying enough structure to distinguish safety-relevant propositions, most of which are relational: "the model plans to deceive the user" and "the user plans to deceive the model" share a concept set and differ only in role assignment. We ask whether the workspace carries the role-filler bindings (which entity fills which role) such a monitor would need, on three frontier language models (Qwen3.6-27B, Gemma-3-12B, Gemma-3-27B-IT), under two lens families (J-lens and R-lens), and with two methods for fitting the role direction (difference-of-means and LRE-gradient). translated_title: 概念袋？测试可言语化工作区中的角色-填充项绑定
translated_abstract: 构建于可言语化工作区之上的运行时对齐监控器，被提议作为一种在模型产生输出之前揭示其“沉默认知”的手段。这类监控器的价值取决于工作区是否携带足够的结构来区分与安全相关的命题，而这些命题大多是关系性的：“模型计划欺骗用户”与“用户计划欺骗模型”共享同一组概念，仅在角色分配上有所不同。我们在三个前沿语言模型（Qwen3.6-27B、Gemma-3-12B、Gemma-3-27B-IT）上，采用两种镜头家族（J-lens 与 R-lens）以及两种拟合角色方向的方法（均值差法与 LRE 梯度法），探究工作区是否携带此类监控器所需的角色-填充项绑定（即哪个实体填充哪个角色）。我们发现了一种清晰的分离现象：工作区携带的是能够引导模型关于角色输出内容的方向，却并不包含模型用于计算这些角色时的内部表示。线性探针能够恢复……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文的核心发现是：在多个前沿模型、两种镜头家族和两种拟合方法下，可言语化工作区只携带能引导模型角色相关输出的方向，而不包含模型实际计算角色绑定所用的内部表示，这意味着基于工作区的运行时对齐监控器难以读取模型内部真实的角色-填充项绑定。
en_tdlr: The paper finds that, across three frontier models, two lens families, and two role-direction fitting methods, the verbalizable workspace carries directions that steer role-related outputs but not the representations the model uses to compute them, implying workspace-based runtime alignment monitors cannot reliably read the model's internal role-filler bindings.
